params.body:
Closes #645

The column "Voorwaarden aanvaard" read `is_first_login` one way on the garage sheet and the other way in `settings/user/index.blade.php`. Accepted is the first login being over (`is_first_login` 0, R P2-3.3), so the user overview was the inverted one.

That view has no route: `/users` (`user.index`) is the garage directory of `DealerController::index`, and `UserController::index` is not routed. No user saw the wrong tick; the garage sheet, which is shown, was right.

## Changes
- Both lists read the column through `Terms::pending`, the one question the layout and the modal already ask.
- `TermsAcceptedReadsOneWayTest` pins the garage sheet: a tick for a user who accepted, a cross for one who did not.
- Finding X-55 marked solved.

Removing the unrouted `UserController::index` and its view is left out on purpose.
params.title: "Voorwaarden aanvaard" reads one way: accepted is the first login being over
